title: QA run · priority:P0 (23/23) · e5f194ba · 2026-10-22 · 19 PASS / 3 PARTIAL / 1 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN
body:
Pre-release P0 smoke for 18.1.0, run on latest `main` at the maintainer's request before merging the Version Packages PR (#24876). One selector (`priority:P0`), one record. The per-clause verdict tables are in the five comments below this body, one per runner group (an issue body has a size cap); this body carries the fingerprint, scope, the derived item verdicts, the one FAIL's reproduction rule, the findings and the probe line.

## Environment fingerprint

- framework `e5f194ba13d8d9a2818c1ece98a9c206fa0c7623` (origin/main at 2026-10-22 12:23Z); `.objectui-sha` `cd14d8eeffe11ae03b6acf82e663c1d293dfdf5f`
- tree: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then `pnpm build --concurrency=2` (76/76 tasks green, 7m15s). `node scripts/check-dev-prereqs.mjs` green.
- console: `pnpm objectui:build` after the framework build, never in parallel, with `OBJECTUI_DEPS_BUILD_CMD='pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter=@object-ui/console^...'`. The first attempt died with a V8 heap OOM (exit 134 in `@object-ui/app-shell#build`, "Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit") at node's default heap; the re-run with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144` succeeded. `dist/.objectui-sha` = pin; `pnpm check:console-sha` passes.
- container: 4 vCPU, 15 GiB; Chromium 141 headless at `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium` (playwright-core 1.63.0).
- boots: stock `examples/app-showcase`, `OS_PORT=<port> objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p <port> -d file:(scratch)/<run>.db` per runner, each runner on its own ports (476xx) and file DB, started with `setsid` and stopped by process group. Walled boot (`OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=isolated`) from a scratch copy declaring `@objectstack/organizations`; `os start` boots for the MCP stdio item; v17 and 18.0.0-next.5 fixtures for the ceremony item, built from npm packages. Timestamps per runner are in the comments.
- execution: five runner agents in parallel (security · api/automation · cli/mcp · boot/console/nav · approvals/crud/studio), plus a sixth, independent agent for the rule-7 re-derivation of the one FAIL. `git status` stayed clean; `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/installed-packages/` never existed.

## FAIL — approvals.account-app-entry acceptance[3] (release-blocking regression)

A non-admin pending approver who opens a request from the account app's Approvals inbox gets a blank request page: no fields, no decision actions, no `can_act=false` explanation. The admin opening the same URL gets the full page. The inbox's in-row Approve/Reject still works (server effects verified), so a non-admin can decide from the list, but Reassign, Send back, Request info, Reply and the request context are unreachable for them.

**Reproduction rule** (fresh showcase boot, own port and DB):
1. As admin: `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/invite-member {"email":"E","role":"member"}`; then `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-up/email {"email":"E","password":"P","name":"QA Approver"}`; resolve the user id U with `GET /api/v1/data/sys_user?email=E`; `POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_position {"user_id":U,"position":"contributor","organization_id":<default org>}` and the same with `"position":"finance"`.
2. Launch a NEW sign-off after the positions exist: as E, `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_invoice {"name":"INV-X","owner":"E","account":<seeded account id>}`, then `PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_invoice/<id> {"status":"sent","issued_on":"2026-10-22"}` (or have the admin submit one; both shapes reproduce). `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/R` → 200 with `viewer.can_act: true` and U in `pending_approvers`.
3. Sign E in through the console form; Avatar › Profile → sidebar Inbox › Approvals (`/_console/apps/com.objectstack.account/component/approvals/inbox`); click the row, or press Enter on it, or cold-load `…/inbox?request=R`.
4. **Expected:** the request's page with its fields and the declared decision action set. **Actual:** `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.account/sys_approval_request/record/R` shows only the heading "Approval Request areq_…", a Flow-initiated chip and empty Details/Timeline tabs; the header carries only "…" and refresh.
5. **Control:** the admin on the same URL sees "Invoice Dual Sign-off (parallel approval)" with its fields and Approve / Reject / Reassign / Send back / Request info / Recall / Reply.

**Rule-2 / rule-7:** reproduced 5× by the first runner (fresh contexts, form sign-in, clicks and direct URL loads, 7–8 s settle) and 3× by an independent second runner on its own boot with its own persona and two new requests (one the persona submitted, one the admin submitted). Identity proven per context with `get-session`; console stamp = pin; no coordinate clicks.

**Mechanism (second runner, network trace + source at the pin):** every request the page makes answers 2xx — `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/R` 200 (`viewer.can_act: true`), `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/R/actions` 200, `GET /api/v1/meta/object/sys_approval_request` and `…/sys_approval_action` 200, two `POST /api/v1/security/explain` 200. The console never calls the data door for the request. In objectui at `cd14d8eeffe1`, `RecordDetailView.tsx` folds the row the approvals door returned through `withoutDeniedFields` against `/auth/me/permissions` (`readablePageRecord = readableRow(...)`), and `MePermissionsProvider.checkField` answers false for any object the permissions answer omits; the persona's answer has no `sys_approval_request` entry (by design: the object is engine-owned, ADR-0103, and `request-read-gate.ts` / `approvals-plugin.ts` keep data-door read closed to non-administrators). So every field but `id` is dropped, including `viewer` and `status`, and every action's `visible` predicate on `record.viewer.can_act` fails. Causal check: rewriting only the persona's `/auth/me/permissions` response in the browser to include read on `sys_approval_request` / `sys_approval_action` made the same page render fully with the right action set. `AppContent.approvalRecordReads.test.tsx` stubs `MePermissionsProvider`, which is why objectui's tests miss it.

**Regression:** yes, against 18.0.0. 18.0.0 shipped objectui `616df6598b42` (the published `@objectstack/console@18.0.0` dist stamp), which still opened requests in the side sheet; the 18.0 sweep's run #24542 passed this clause with the same persona shape. The side sheet was replaced by the served record page in objectui `a91f6bbb1` (objectui#12484, 2026-10-21), which entered this repo's pin with #25160 (`cf153eb2e535` → `56cf4d8e89b7`; `cf153eb2e535` does not contain it, `56cf4d8e89b7` does). Disposition: **product defect**, fix belongs in objectui; granting `sys_approval_request` read to members would hide the symptom by opening a door the platform keeps closed on purpose.

## Findings outside the clauses

- **Data API paging (pre-existing, not a regression):** `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_account?$skip=-5` (and `?$skip=-1&$top=3`, and `POST …/query {"offset":-5}`) answer **500 INTERNAL_ERROR** (server log: the SQL builder's "A non-negative integer must be provided to offset"); `?$top=abc`, `?$top=-1` and `POST …/query {"limit":-1}` answer 200 as if no limit was sent, while the POST door refuses `{"limit":"ten"}` 400 VALIDATION_FAILED. Cause: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` coerces with `Number(options.limit)` / `Number(options.offset)` and never range-checks. Re-measured by the run lead on a separate boot. The same two lines are in the published `@objectstack/metadata-protocol@18.0.0`, so 18.0.0 behaves the same. Extracted as its own card (below).
- **Authorization-adjacent, low severity:** one observation beside `ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed` acceptance[5]'s doors (field-level security, no value leaked) — **detail withheld pending maintainer**. It moves no verdict.
- **Transient:** one `showcase-smoke.spec.ts` surface (`Hours by Status (Chart)`) died once with Playwright `Target crashed` before any assertion; it did not reproduce (6/6 twice in isolation, 49/49 on a full re-run). Treated as environment.

## Checklist-accuracy findings and fixture gaps (for the wave anchor; not extracted)

- approvals.account-app-entry: steps[5–6] and acceptance[1], [3], [4] still say "drawer"; since objectui#12484 the surface is the served `sys_approval_request` record page, and the inbox also has in-row and bulk Approve/Reject, so acceptance[3] should name which surface it scores.
- platform-core.boot-health acceptance[2] quotes the deployment-policy flow line with ⚠; the banner now prints it with ℹ.
- platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render steps[5] describes Account › Approvals as `sys_approval_request/my_pending`; it is served as the `approvals:inbox` component.
- platform-core.nav-surfaces-render steps[0] says `test:smoke`, which runs every spec in `e2e/`, not only the pin; `examples/app-showcase/test-results/` is not git-ignored, so a run without `--output` leaves untracked files.
- records-forms.crud-roundtrip acceptance[4]: no step sets a date (the localized-date half was checked on a seeded date field); acceptance[6]: `f_formula` cannot show re-derivation with unchanged inputs, only `f_autonumber` does.
- studio-authoring.first-run-loop steps[3]: the Changes panel goes straight to "Publish all".
- automation.packaged-flow-disable-durable: the urgent `showcase_task` create needs a `project` (400 without it); the flow runs list caps `limit` at 100 (`limit=200` answers 400, which can read as "no runs").
- integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix steps[0]/knownGaps: with `driver:'mongo'` plus `config.password`, the credential refusal is reported, not the name refusal; the name refusal appears only with no credential key.
- platform-core.seed-integrity: `f_password` reads back masked and should be listed as expected-masked.
- api-backend.query-contract-matrix: no stock persona fits the contributor fixture; the runner minted one (a fixture of its own making).
- ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed: `os start` logs at `warn` by default, so its INFO-line oracles need `--log-level info`.
- cli.organization-ownership-ceremony: on a v17 DB the apply blocks at `rewrite` until a v18 boot has been refused once (not printed by the plan); the ceremony needs the deployment's auth composition (`OS_AUTH_SECRET` or `--dev`) or it blocks at `authored-conversion`; on a raw v17 copy `refused_comment_reactions_unconverted` comes first, and `comment-reactions --apply` needs `--yes` non-interactively. Fixture gaps: the v17 DB came from `cli@17.7.0` on a minimal app, and the next.5 fixture had no pending mail jobs (jobsRewritten 0).
- platform-core.v18-boot-refusals: the SecurityPlugin rig is refused earlier by the "mounts no auth" gate; the `createIdentityObjectsPlugin()` refusal is reached with `os serve --dev --no-server --preset minimal`.
- access-security.write-path-guards and owd-sharing-matrix: their pins do not reach several clauses (write-path A4, bulk half of A5, A6; owd A2, A3, A5 on stock grants) — candidates for pin promotion.
- access-security.crud-permission-matrix knownGaps calls a baseline member's `/data/sys_user` read "self-scoped"; measured, it lists every user of the single organization (org-scoped). Wording to check.
- `objectstack verify --rls` lists `showcase_announcement` (public_read) as "probe cannot read"; that is the probe persona's owner-scoped policy, not an OWD contradiction, but reads like one.
- RUNNER environment facts worth adding: `pnpm objectui:build` needs a larger V8 heap here (`NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144`); on the sqlite-wasm driver a hand-placed grant row must be written while the server is stopped, or the server's next save overwrites it; a selective, non-reproducing Playwright `Target crashed` is renderer-level, not a chart defect.
- showcase fixture: the boot warns that sharing rule `share_new_inquiries_with_field_ops` (business unit `bu_field_ops`) expands to no recipients on a fresh boot.

## Off-clause probe line (rule 8)

About 60 runner-minutes in total, after the clauses had verdicts, as admin, plain members, contributor/liaison/approver personas, org owner and operator on the walled boot, and anonymous. Doors: data CRUD and query (empty / missing / unknown / negative / non-numeric values on ids and paging params), auth sign-in (empty email, missing password, unknown email, 32 bad-credential combinations, bearer after sign-out), MCP stdio admission (empty, whitespace and `osk_` keys, every enable-switch spelling), approvals act/read as non-participant and with a forged actor, walled-boot doors beyond the clauses (draft, rollback, dashboard, translation writes, package PATCH, automation clone/delete), studio clone with unknown/empty ids, writes into the read-only showcase package. Found: the paging defect above, the withheld low-severity observation above, and a cosmetic one (record History shows a currency change raw, "— → 1234567", while the header shows "$1,234,567.00"). No existence leak on foreign vs nonexistent ids, no account enumeration on sign-in.

## Handover

None — every selected item has a verdict.
